output.summary: I found nothing that contradicts the SRD. The goblin warrior data entry at monsters.py:166 matches the stat block on every value I checked, including both attacks with their 1d4 Advantage riders. Of the six scenarios, CLS-ROG-01, CLS-WIZ-02, CMB-03, CMB-06, SPELLS-02 and MON-02 are consistent and use the goblin only as a target or fixture. Five of the tests are consistent and four of the seven CLS-ROG-01 tests are unrelated. test_mon02_traits under-asserts: it covers only the Scimitar rider when Advantage applies. It misses the Shortbow rider, the no-Advantage case and the cancel case behind the stage A ambiguity. Of the code lines found only by page number, monsters.py:131 is the goblin minion and :202 the goblin boss. combat.py:1389 and :1399 are the boss's Redirect Attack. All four are unrelated. I did not check the engine's Nimble Escape or the Advantage-rider logic itself, because no related code lines pointed to it. There are no SRD tests for this unit.
